fields.title: 📖 When Fiqh becomes scarce
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** رضي الله عنه said:

***"You are in a time in which its Fuqahāʾ are many and its reciters are few; in it the limits of the Qurʾān are preserved and its letters are neglected.***

***And a time will come upon the people in which their reciters are many and their Fuqahāʾ are few; the letters of the Qurʾān will be preserved, but its limits neglected."***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The Salaf did not attend only to reciting the letters, but to preserving the limits, the meanings and the deeds. True knowledge is not shown only on the tongue, but in the Qurʾān guiding the person.

immutable.source: 📝 Mālik ibn Anas, al-Muwaṭṭaʾ, Kitāb Qaṣr aṣ-Ṣalāh fi-s-Safar, Bāb Jāmiʿ aṣ-Ṣalāh, Nr. 427
